title: Tenure and Level Scaling of Closing Reserves — Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
## Scaling of closing reserves by tenure and level (Cartwise Shopper Payouts)

**Clause.** When a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account closes, the closing reserves held back from the final disbursement for 30 days are added together, and that sum is scaled by tenure and level: a shopper whose contractor account was first activated 48 or more whole months ago and who is at Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond level has the sum of the closing reserves halved; a shopper activated 48 or more whole months ago who is below Full-Service Shopper Platinum level has that sum multiplied by 0.75; any other shopper keeps the full sum. The scaled sum is rounded to the cent, and it is the scaled sum that the final disbursement holds back.

**Records.** Both conditions are read from the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record:

- *Tenure* is the number of whole months from the date the contractor account was first activated to the day of the closing; 48 or more whole months qualifies, 47 whole months does not.
- *Level* is the shopper's level on that record. Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond, and a level named with "or above" or "or below" is read in that order. "Below Full-Service Shopper Platinum level" therefore covers Shop-Only Shopper through Full-Service Shopper Gold.

**Decision table**

| First activated | Level | Sum of closing reserves |
|---|---|---|
| 48 or more whole months ago | Platinum or Diamond | Halved (multiplied by 0.5) |
| 48 or more whole months ago | Shop-Only Shopper to Gold | Multiplied by 0.75 |
| Fewer than 48 whole months ago | Any level | Kept in full |

**Worked examples (hypothetical inputs).** The closing reserves held back come to 20.00, 20.00 and 12.50, a sum of 52.50.

- Activated 60 whole months ago, Full-Service Shopper Diamond: 52.50 halved is 26.25.
- Activated 48 whole months ago, Full-Service Shopper Silver: 52.50 multiplied by 0.75 is 39.375, rounded to the cent as 39.38.
- Activated 47 whole months ago, Full-Service Shopper Platinum: the full 52.50.

The multiplier acts once, on the sum of all the closing reserves together, and the rounding to the cent is applied to the scaled sum.
